sources.scope: JMdict-attributed 殆ど adverbial positive/negative and nominal large-majority senses.
sources.notes: Near-zero need not establish zero. No invented percentage or universal mutually exclusive あまり/ほとんど choice.

sources.scope: Actual JMdict-attributed 言える entry: 言える and 云える, reading いえる, under the modern ichidan ability-to-say sense.
sources.notes: Accept 云える and its regular negative 云えない as same-word response-label spellings. The separate archaic sense does not make the modern first sense archaic. Recognition is not a spelling-frequency claim.

placement.policy: Primary N4 full-construction classification, including the attested colloquial affirmative qualification. Existing word-card levels and older exercises are unchanged.
placement.foundationReason: All negative frames or complete alternative predicates are supplied. These are contextual selections and supplied-form interpretations, not unsupplied paradigm assembly; no new hard gate or chapter lock.

coverage.groupContexts: Negative strength across frequency, amount and adjective intensity; ほとんど polarity across item sets, portions and event series; interpretation across time scope, colloquial reassurance, nominal majority, near-zero amounts and unquantified progress.
coverage.accounting: Opposite-polarity versions share keys. Related frequency interpretations reuse the negative-frequency key; little-sleep interpretation shares the portion key. This conservatively counts nine operation/context keys, not twenty-four independent situations.
coverage.perFacetKeys: Three per negative-strength and predicate-polarity facet; five per interpretation facet.

boundaries: A zero amount can support an あまり understatement. The complete-denial selections explicitly request total denial; feedback rejects the weaker assertion for that operation, not as universally false or ungrammatical.
Where a small nonzero amount is stated, literal 全然-negative is not an equivalent complete denial. These bounded tasks exclude deliberate exaggeration.
ほとんど-negative does not always mean zero and does not guarantee nonzero. Positive near-whole descriptions do not supply an exact percentage or an exceptionless all claim.
Modern casual affirmative 全然いいよ is independently dictionary-supported. No universal negative-only prohibition or blanket formal-register permission is taught.
Finite predicate selections request one printed completion or its hiragana counterpart. They do not grade unrestricted paraphrases or new verb morphology.
Numerals are context, not counter-reading targets or universal thresholds. Old interval, distribution and higher-grade targets retain their levels and owners.

independentReview.scope: All 24 complete tasks, 48 base options and feedback branches, initial 52 and revised 64 accepted completions, 217 lexical spans, occurrence records, changed article/source/format sections and curriculum additions.

findings.finding: Semantic interpretation-label instructions did not explicitly require copying only the displayed spelling, but the accepted lists omitted the verified same-word 云える and 云えない forms.
findings.resolution: Added 云える to six supported and 云えない to six not-established tasks. Kept canonical labels and base options unchanged, added precise dictionary evidence and refreshed the twelve context fingerprints.
findings.reviewerQualification: High confidence in dictionary recognition and actual rejection; medium confidence in the initial implicit spelling-contract interpretation. Original reviewer accepted the additive remedy.

independentReview.additionalClarification: Six shortened negative-strength instructions now supply 全然（ぜんぜん） while retaining the literal-description, explicit-zero and no-understatement constraints. Their fingerprints were refreshed; original reviewer found no regression.
independentReview.coverage: Nine conservatively shared operation/context keys accepted; three keys per selection facet and five per interpretation facet. Supported tasks are not credited with their paired negative claim's extra inference demand.
independentReview.limits: Bounded linguistic/editorial review, not exhaustive correctness, native-speaker certification, spelling-frequency evidence or device acceptance. Runtime evidence is separate.

native.observed: Staged real-corpus parser, wrong/correct choose/type, normalized recording, scrolled Check, article Back and matching history passed. The revised interpretation pool uses the newly added 云 spellings for correct typed answers.
native.limits: Not an exhaustive per-item/per-mode matrix or phone acceptance. Keyboard captures precede scrolling to Check and do not show it simultaneously.
